title: Nothing Phone 4b Price in Pakistan: Post-Launch Cost Guide
meta_title: Nothing Phone 4b Price in Pakistan: Cost Guide
meta_description: Understand Nothing Phone 4b Pakistan pricing after launch, official UK and India prices, PTA and import costs, warranty, variants and how to verify an offer.
excerpt: A post-launch Pakistan price guide for Phone 4b that separates official international launch prices from unverified rupee estimates and explains PTA, region, warranty and total cost.
author: Nothing Pakistan Editorial Team

faqs.question: What is the Nothing Phone 4b price in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: A defensible Pakistan price requires a current offer for an identified regional unit with storage, both-IMEI PTA status and warranty stated. Nothing Pakistan does not publish an unverified rupee estimate as a confirmed retail price.

faqs.question: What is the official Nothing Phone 4b launch price?
faqs.answer: At the time of this check, Nothing lists the 8+128 GB Phone 4b at £299 in the UK. The India base price was announced at ₹34,999. These establish regional positioning but are not Pakistan retail prices.

faqs.question: Can I convert the UK price directly into Pakistani rupees?
faqs.answer: A currency conversion is only the handset-price component. Pakistan cost may also include logistics, exchange spread, duties, PTA registration, seller margin, warranty support and accessories.

faqs.question: Does the Phone 4b Pakistan price include PTA tax?
faqs.answer: Only if the seller explicitly states that the exact phone is permanently PTA compliant and both genuine IMEIs verify successfully. Never infer PTA inclusion from a high price or an 'official' badge.

faqs.question: How much is Phone 4b PTA tax?
faqs.answer: Use the exact IMEIs and current official DIRBS process. Static online tax figures can become outdated or apply to a different assessed record or registration route.

faqs.question: Why do Pakistan Phone 4b prices differ between sellers?
faqs.answer: Offers can differ by region, storage, colour, PTA status, condition, import cost, exchange timing, warranty quality, return terms and seller margin. Compare all of these before treating two listings as equivalent.

faqs.question: Is the Indian Phone 4b the same as the international model?
faqs.answer: No. The India specification includes a 6,000 mAh battery and regional connectivity and NFC differences; the international model lists 5,200 mAh. Identify the version before comparing price.

faqs.question: Is Phone 4b cheaper than Phone 4a?
faqs.answer: It is positioned below Phone 4a in official markets, but a Pakistan offer can reverse the expected value after PTA, region, stock and warranty costs. Compare verified total prices for equivalent conditions.

faqs.question: Should I buy a non-PTA Phone 4b because it is cheaper?
faqs.answer: Only after both genuine IMEIs are disclosed, their status is checked, the current official registration amount is known, and the final total remains worthwhile. The headline handset price is incomplete.

faqs.question: Does a Phone 4b international warranty work in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Do not assume cross-region warranty coverage. Nothing support guidance and seller terms can restrict service to the purchase region. Obtain the Pakistan claim route in writing before paying.

faqs.question: Which Phone 4b configuration should I price-check?
faqs.answer: Start with the official 8+128 GB international configuration. A 256 GB listing should identify its region because the detailed specification marks 8+256 GB as India-only.

faqs.question: When should I wait instead of buying Phone 4b?
faqs.answer: Wait when the seller cannot confirm region, both IMEIs, PTA status, warranty, return terms or final price, or when launch scarcity makes Phone 4b cost too close to stronger alternatives.
